### Notes
- Licensed under the AGPL.
- The AI assistant is opt-in and needs your own API key (Claude, Grok, OpenAI) or a local OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama.
- Press Play first: browsers only arm audio from a user gesture.
- Patterns run on strudel-rs. Nearly all web Strudel notation works as is; Help → Dialect lists the differences.
